title: Bag shoes and put them in the box
masks_caveat: the shoe-pair outline covers one shoe of the pair; once the pair is in the box (from about 8.0 s) the bag's outline covers it instead.
contact_roles: both hands set the pair down and turn it, pull the bag over it and lift it into the box. Parts of this clip's contact were corrected by a reviewer watching the video, where the automatic cues missed it (those frames are marked as reviewer-corrected in the data).
